scenarios.title: ACE definitions are defined and discoverable
scenarios.reason: Normal ACE content should have valid identifiers and the source entries the loader expects.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Every definition family has source entries, non-blank IDs, and no duplicate IDs within that family.

scenarios.title: ACE Lua names do not collide accidentally
scenarios.reason: The addon must not silently replace another ACE function or table during loading.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The namespace scan completes without an accidental cross-file collision.

scenarios.title: The points model stays internally consistent
scenarios.reason: The same input should produce safe, deterministic point results in the offline model.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The model returns the expected point result for each supported input shape.

scenarios.title: ACE entities survive a normal lifecycle
scenarios.reason: A player should be able to create, use, and remove an ACE entity without runtime errors.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The entity reaches each lifecycle step and is removed without a runtime error.

scenarios.title: A representative tank duel completes cleanly
scenarios.reason: A normal shot-impact-damage sequence should finish without hangs or out-of-scope errors.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The scenario records fire, impact, damage, and clean termination.

scenarios.title: Representative fire-rate smoke finishes with artifacts
scenarios.reason: A normal fire-rate sample should finish and report measurements instead of hanging.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The performance runner finds a bounded scenario with its declared perf artifact.
